answer: To block mass-produced identities, standing grows like a pearl, one layer per verified deed, never in bulk. A comet, an unpredictable sweep, inspects a sample of layers and strips any that fail. An identity caught with fake layers falls to its nadir and must regrow from scratch. 1000 fakes need 1000 fully layered pearls; layers take real deeds and real time, and sweeps strip fakes. One honest agent grows one pearl and keeps it.
